summary: @c1-ease/bank postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded VPS
details: The package is an inert shim whose only behavior is a callback to an attacker-controlled host. The `postinstall` script `beacon.cjs` and the top-level `require()` of `index.js` both fire a POST to the hardcoded endpoint `https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc`, carrying host identifiers (hostname via `os.hostname()`, install path, `process.cwd()`, `process.version`, and the package name). TLS certificate verification is disabled on the request (`rejectUnauthorized: false`). `index.js` otherwise exports a Proxy of no-op functions and provides no advertised functionality; the scoped name `@c1-ease/bank` and the generic 'Compatibility shim.' description are consistent with a dependency-confusion / namesquat payload whose sole purpose is to confirm code execution on the installer's machine and report host metadata to the operator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
